extension.summary: Six Degrees - every direction is a connection.
extension.description: Browse your library by association, like a transit map. The film in focus is a station; Up rides its director's line, Right its lead actor, Left the second star, Down the films of the same year and genre. OK re-centres, Back retraces the route. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.10 - Sets row in the Library panel; fix for controls disappearing with Reduce motion on. Code clean-up for the Kodi repository checks.
